name: Wuhan Citms Technology CO.,LTD.
summary: Wuhan Citms Technology CO.,LTD. specializes in providing end-to-end solutions for smart city and intelligent transportation initiatives. Their core services involve system integration, custom software development, engineering design, and comprehensive support. The company's product portfolio is extensive, featuring advanced systems for traffic management and enforcement, such as automated red-light detection, intelligent road vehicle surveillance, and automatic parking violation capture. They also offer mobile policing tools, traffic data management platforms, and systems for vehicle control, including restricted-zone access. For violation processing, their solutions include self-service portals, auxiliary tools for offense handling, internet behavior management, and SMS notifications for online traffic infractions. Additionally, their public security offerings comprise specialized industry control systems, accident management support, integrated public security information systems, and specific illegal plug-in solutions for public security bureau traffic police detachments. Beyond product provision, Wuhan Citms Technology undertakes various significant projects. These include maintenance contracts for road traffic signal control equipment, the development of audio and video monitoring systems for detention facilities, stadium video surveillance installations, the construction of public security command centers, and police monitoring infrastructure projects. Their primary client base consists of local government agencies. Wuhan Citms Technology CO.,LTD. was established in 2007 and is headquartered in Wuhan, China.
